query: SELECT ?item ?code ?label ?category ?coordinate WHERE { ?item wdt:P429 ?code . OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P373 ?category . } OPTIONAL { ?item rdfs:label ?label . FILTER(LANG(?label)="ja") } OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P625 ?coordinate . } }

verification.coordinatePolicy: Coordinates are informational only. Multiple P625 coordinates remain null; use the municipality-code-linked category for photo matching. Never use proximity alone as municipality evidence.

categoryEvidence.kind: Wikidata category main topic and Commons sitelink
